web/src/i18n/en.ts.allocationCapacity.title: Weekly capacity before and after
web/src/i18n/en.ts.allocationCapacity.basis: Proposal dates: {from}–{through}. Figures cover each full Monday–Sunday week; the proposal applies only within its chosen dates. Load uses confirmed allocations and task estimates, with linked work counted once. Other proposed allocations are excluded. Over-capacity marks use the existing daily confirmation rule. Saving recalculates; confirmation is unchanged.
web/src/i18n/en.ts.allocationCapacity.partial: Some work is outside your project access. Available hours are shown where known; before, after and overload cannot be assessed. No hidden work details are included.
web/src/i18n/en.ts.allocationCapacity.unavailable: A changed allocation calendar prevents a reliable load calculation. Before, after and overload are unavailable.
web/src/i18n/en.ts.allocationCapacity.incomplete: Load figures are known subtotals. Active work includes {unestimated} unestimated tasks and {undated} tasks with no due date; an unmarked week is not proof of spare capacity.
web/src/i18n/en.ts.allocationCapacity.provisional: Some availability is provisional. Those weeks show availability and overload as unavailable until reconciled.
web/src/i18n/en.ts.allocationCapacity.completeProposal: Choose the linked work and complete the proposal to compare the after load.
